name: Roadside shrine
description: A small wayside shrine: a square grey-brown stone post on a low footing carrying a stone niche under a steep gabled roof of weathered boards; in the niche a painted icon panel, a lit candle and a clay pot of wildflowers, with a little bunch of flowers laid at its foot.
